name: Hiding Spot
description: Lockers, closets, under-bed gaps: enterable volumes that break the stalker's acquisition. Owns entry and exit rules — occupancy, noise on entry, time to settle — and the detection check when a pursuer searches the room. Entering a locker the stalker SAW you enter is death, and that rule lives here rather than in the AI because it is a property of the spot: the locker lies, and the lie is only good if no one watched you tell it. While hidden, the player's movement and camera constraints belong to their own components; this publishes the hidden fact and the spot's exposure state, which world.stalker_ai and combat.fear_sanity_meter both consume — hiding should calm acquisition while sharpening dread, and that split only works if the two systems read the same fact independently.

inputs.name: settleSeconds
inputs.description: Time from entry until the hidden state takes effect. The gap is the gamble: dive in with the stalker six steps behind and the settle window decides whether the lie was fast enough.

inputs.name: entryNoiseRadius
inputs.description: Radius in which entering the spot is audible, reported through the same noise channel as footsteps. Slamming a locker is a confession; the radius is what makes the last three steps before hiding a crouch.

inputs.name: detectIfSeenEntering
inputs.description: Whether witnessed entry defeats the spot entirely. True by default — a hiding place that works while watched is a force field, and force fields are a different genre.

inputs.name: maxOccupants
inputs.description: How many entities the spot hides at once. One, because a two-person locker turns a dread beat into a comedy beat — which a co-op mode may want, and can now say so in data.

outputs.name: isOccupied
outputs.description: True while anyone is inside, settled or not. An occupied locker refuses entry; it does not stack tenants.

outputs.name: occupantHidden
outputs.description: True only after the settle window completes with detection rules satisfied. This is the fact world.stalker_ai trusts — entry is not hiding.
